Kacee: Kacee is at home on the farm where things make sense. Like Gus way after her, she understands the momentum of objects and the moods of animals. She's wasted in the city where people spend too much time staring at themselves.
Kacie: Kacie deals with things she can see and touch. Ghosts, superstitions and other paranormal phenomena are none of her business. She's not the most romantic girl in the Kingdom.
Kadey: This girl understands phycial situations. That is to say, if she and a bunch of girlfriends decided to go white-water rafting and none of them had ever done it before, very quickly the guide on the boat would realise Kadey grasped the concept better than anyone else on board and therefore place her in a leadership position. (And, true, she has a great smile when it comes out, especially when she's soaking wet and barking instructions at people.)
Kadi: Kadi is busy and she hasn't got time to bother if people misspell her name. Deep down she's a sensitive, romantic soul, but geez, you'd barely think that if you only recently met her. She's neither dainty or meticulous and she'll be financially independent faster than most of her peers.
Kaele: No, she ain't no leafy green vegetable folks. She’s an accomplished event organiser who turns every obstacle into an opportunity. That sounds like a cliché, I know, but why sit around and sulk when you have the full function of your arms, legs and eyes? This is what she will ask you, and rightly so. She’s mobile and she’s optimistic. If we could turn her into some kind of national vaccine we'd not only save the world, but we'd make a shitload of money. Amen.
Kaelene:
Is she the Queen of Sophistication? Well, I think a more appropriate question is, "Are you talking about me, dickhead? If you are, make it good, and if it can't be good make it funny." 
This is what Kaelene would tell you. Never full of lies, once in while full of delusion and even less is she full of shit, Kaelene is one of those girls whose presence isn't easily forgotten. She'd rather take the kids to Euro Disney than spend a couple of days on a plush river cruise on the Seine, purely because she doesn’t like sitting around doing nothing either.
Kaethe: Yep, she's Irish. She's also mad. She's also lovely.
Kahli: Ever seen Jurrassic Park, the movie? It was a great book. Anyway, Kahli is a veloca-fucken-raptor. Did you hear me? You got a gun? Or maybe a helicopter?
Kahran: Picture Karen, born of Northern European parents, like Sweden or somewhere. She is therefore slightly more aloof than normal, but rollicking and independent good fun, nonetheless.
Kahri: Kahri is a good-looking, elemental girl who seems to attract unstable men.
Kaia: Kaia is a sensual, ambitious and well-travelled woman with a healthy view of herself. As a result of spending her life having to constantly spell her name to people, she takes no shit from anyone and she doesn’t tolerate fools.
Kaicee: Kaicee bites her fingernails to the quick, which means that no one ever sees the dirt and grease that she deals with daily.
Kailee: Rather surprisingly, Kailee is a relatively clean-cut young lass who, in adulthood, remains forever young. Yes, she has huge stores of energy and we suspect this is the key. Keep her outdoors and keep her active: these are the instructions that are written on the box Kailee arrives in, and we suggest you, the Kailee owner, take heed. Then again, after not too long you will realise that, like an untameable horse, NO ONE every really owns a Kailee. The best you can hope for is to hold on for as long as possible and enjoy the ride. (Big honest smile. Lots of friends.)
Kaine: Kaine is just a little bit dangerous and unpredictable, and it makes a welcome change. Well, unless you’re the one in a hospital bed because of Kaine crashing her motocross bike into the crowd having mis-timed a jump.
Kairo: City girl. Does she over-think problems? Sometimes. Usually however she grinds her way through issues. Generally she's correct and she certainly enjoys the problem-solving process. She's quite bright, you know.
Kaitlin: Perhaps it's the adrenalin of it, but she's one of these people that would make a great war photographer.
Kaitlyn: The name of a boomerang made out of titanium that is travelling through the air at 320 miles per hour. It's worth a fortune and we all want one, but can you catch? Do you dare even try?...
Kaiyah: Kaiyah moves through life like one of those Tibetan prayer flags blowing in a stiff breeze. Kaiyah is her own cat, true enough, and most people wonder if she's on the right path. OF COURSE she's on the right path! So, yes, Kaiyah is here, she's there, she's disappearing for days on end with friends you've never met and she has no fear of the sea. The question of 'what will she do with her life', is something that may never be any of her business, let alone anyone else's. It's hard to say. Don't let her sit indoors for too long however.
Kalani: Kalani is almost an endangered species. She’s never known any predators, she believes everyone she meets is truly good and she doesn’t eat processed food. As you might imagine, her smile fills up any space she occupies and she therefore seems to be incredibly lucky most of the time, because there are some people who the universe just adores. It’s just how it is.
Kalaye: Often private and peculiar, Kalaye is rarely seen in the jungle during daylight hours. Sneaking furtively from one well-shaded tree (ie. secretive house/job/lover) to another quite regularly, almost in total silence, Kalaye tends to surprise everyone all the time. A welcoming smile and a friendly nature means people are only surprised by her evermore. Know what I mean?
Kaley: Never slothful or useless, Kaley is a 21st century girl with an eye on how to do things cleaner, more efficiently and with more compassion than just about any of her peers. Mature beyond her years is this girl, with a never-say-die attitude. In fact, she might even be a little bit TOO optimistic.
Kali: Kali tends to zing here, she zings there, and she struggles to say the word 'no', which means she's generally flat-out, and laughing, and travelling lots. If she's a couch potato you might need to check her out - she might be from another planet. Overall, however, Kali's laugh can be heard a mile away, she has a mountain of friends and quite a subtle eye on where she's headed. She aint no fool.
Kalicia: As a little girl you can always spot her in the supermarket. She's the one eating her way into that bottom shelf in the chocolate aisle, leaving a trail of foil wrappers and carnage behind her. Good luck mum!
Kalina: Despite having a name like the type of motorcar that could be described as a people-mover, Kalina is a good, normal person. She won’t find a cure for HIV or malaria but she won’t deliberately pour sugar into the fuel tank of your car in order to destroy it, either.
Kalo: (Pron. Kar-loor.) A unique name has produced a unique woman – sensuous, big personality, great singer/actor/sculptor/painter and the life of the party. If a doomsday festival is ever held in light of Earth’s imminent demise, her name would be on the VIP guest list.
Kama: Don't be shy, lass. Everyone else feels the same as you, deep down. So go on…..be zany! Be crazy! Light up this world with your silliest ideas, that's the key.
Kamen: Like a million other girls out there, Kamen doesn't experience enough random sexy surprises in her life. And they don't even have to be sexy all the time, either. A trip to the movies? A sudden invite to a picnic on the beach? Even the silly idea of taking a bottle of wine up on the roof? Kamen is need of something, we reckon. She's done enough for the team and it's about time they remembered that. The End.
Kamina: Very hard to find in the wild, Kamina hides herself into dark crannies. Sometimes she lives in the trees, other times she'll steal another creature's burrow. Is she nocturnal? We're not sure. People have been bitten by her, at least, that's the rumour, although we've never actually encountered anyone directly who that's happened to. Certainly, of the few Kaminas we've seen none of them appeared to be aggressive in any way. As a mammal however, she's very intelligent and a great climber.
Kamisha: Like an oil tanker with a pissed skipper, Kamisha is here, she's there, in fact, where the hell is she? Not prone to a dedicated career, she has the ability to chop and change in a moments notice. She frustrates her lovers/partners but her rather kooky sense of humour means life is rarely dull, which is a good thing.
Kammy: The all-loving hippy mother who is rarely on time.
Kandise: Her tolerance is questionable, but not her partying capacity. Yes, she is a gossip and she has more shoes than God, and as a single lass she wades through her male admirers like a bored farmer trying to get back to the tractor through the heard of hungry cows that think he's bringing fodder. Note: If you haven't got two pennies to rub together gents, forget it.
Kara: The Wrestler, who in reality would prefer to knife her opponent in the throat when they are on the canvas, rather than let them up when they begin to plead for mercy.
Karalee: Does she spend too much time mopping up after everyone? Perhaps she's getting her comeuppance because as a young girl she was a fair-dinkum disaster area. I know, back then it was her job, but honestly! How often can a little girl set one kitchen on fire, I'm not sure. She might even hold a record for it. So, no, life ain't a straight, placid line for this one. Like a constantly rumbling volcano that you swear might erupt at any moment, Karalee forces one to prepare for every eventuality.
Karen: In a world of death, famine, war, drought, disease, suicide, mortgage payments and stubbed toes, Karen is a welcome relief because she is Ultra-Double Normal. (ie. compassionate, optimistic, occasionally very sexy and surprisingly adventurous.) Well, unless she’s the Karen of her dreams who attends kink parties and has so many men after her it isn’t funny, but these Karens aren’t seen very often in the wild.
Karene: Darlin', I know you're desperate to get over that mountian because you think that on the otherside of it is nirvana. I'm telling you, when you get there, you're still going to be Karene. So, why not stop for a second and have a cup of tea. Perhaps you've passed over the mountain already?
Kari: You couldn't knock your opponent out, but just when you think you're ahead on points and cruising to an easy victory, BANG!!!!! The mean left hook arrived from nowhere and caught you smack in the middle of the face. Next thing you know you're lying flat on the canvas seeing stars. Never underestimate the KARI !!!!
Karin: Like someone born on an astrological cusp who is pissed off about it, Karin is over having to tell people that her name is spelt differently. But, it’s made her a person not known for finessing. Good friends with Nathan.
Karina: Karina is a perennial optimist who is sporty and outdoorsy, and competitive to boot.  She’s the sort of knock-about girl who, while at the same time as expanding her reputation in the scientific world, also represents Australia in netball at the Commonwealth Games.
Karine: Karine, hear this: It’s never over ‘til it’s over. Fight the tempest within! FIGHT IT, I SAY! GRIT YOUR TEETH AND FIGHT!...GODDAMN IT!!!
Karissa: Flowers - Karissa hasn't really got time for them. If some man turns up with a bunch she immediately suspects he's feeling guilty about something. Either way, it's not a good look.
Karla: Karla is a very expensive knife that is crafted in Germany. She’s probably the sharpest thing in the world so be very careful. Wet or dry, however, she is an incredibly sexy woman.
Karlee: Off with the fairies when she's on her own, Karlee is occasionally bitterly disappointed what her existence in the real world means. She hates filling out all forms, for instance, and wishes we humans would be just good to each other. It's all about the 'vibe' with this girl.
Karleen: Nup, she’s no redneck folks. Karleen is sanguine, she plans ahead and her radar for people, be they fools or otherwise, is spot on. Quite the sexpot, I’ll have you know.
Karly: Well, let’s just hope she’s not stuck in some kind of boring-as-bat-shit office job. Yes, no one needs to suffer this fate and God knows there are millions out there who do, but this girl would have her heart ripped out bit by bit, one day at a time. Karly, you see, is a hopeless romantic who needs to get naked in waterfalls, ride horses through forests and make love under the stars.
Karlye: Karlye is one of those rather remarkable creatures who indulges her passion and, without even meaning to, becomes world-reknowned. Perhaps she's a famous violinist? Maybe she designed a fail-safe winch mechanism for ski-lifts? I wonder if she's one of those sculptors who makes pieces large enough to be seen from a kilometre away? But you get the drift - Karlye is a delicious woman with a completely unique approach to everything and everyone. If humans ever get their shit together and end up living on another planet, we should think about cloning her.
Karma: Like they didn’t call her Comeuppance eh? Or An Eye For An Eye. Anyway, the name invites her to be a wise old sage from when she was born but this is an absurd notion. Time and experience are the only things which can lead to this, and in life Karma reacted against what her parents wanted the most. She parties harder than anyone and she is fiercely independent.
Karmen: Why is it millionaires never seem to carry around any cash? I've never worked it out. It may be because she only sees the big picture and, let's face it, actual money doesn't really get a look-in, at this scale.
Karol: In her early years she was no where near as chilled out as her Carol/Carole cousins, but she recovered. Karol has long since given up correcting people who misspell her name, but yes, it irks her from time to time. In life she is very smart, saucy and inventive in the bedroom and yet reasonably chilled outside it. Not built to tolerate idiots, Karol will just shake her head at a buffoon in her midst and walk away rather than get into a long involved discussion with such a person. But no second chances here kids. If you piss Karol off then you can delete her number from your phone because she's almost certainly deleted yours. And amen to that, because you're probably worth deleting.
Karolin: Karolin's been a member of the Mile High Club for years. Just don't tell her kids that!
Karon: Well, she may not be the full general, but she's definitely a well-respected, determined, exceptionally brave and decorated Colonel. Don't give her fucking star signs you wankers, give her some whisky, maybe even a cigar when the race is over and won. She doesn't go in for $300 hairdos or 3-day spas, she's more into the real world: a good vegie garden; a well maintained rifle collection; perhaps even a newly installed gearbox on the 4WD. And she'll get you there all right! Just trust her.
Karri: Lentils, beans, legumes, all varieties of nuts, dried fruits, organic vegetables all those different kinds of crushed grains - these are the kinds of things that Karri wishes she ate more of, and plans to!
Karyn: A proactive woman who is angered that no one can spell her name. She therefore rides abit taller in the saddle, and expects abit more from both the menu and the staff as a result. Great at bridge.
Kasey: Kasey aspires to be the only female mechanic in the Ferrari Formula 1 racing team.
Kasmira: Kasmira has sticky fingers, and cunning ways to retrieve the assests of ex-husbands.
Kassia: Wow. In a past life Kassia was a giant Maori warrior who killed more enemy tribe members than anyone. Not really prone to multi-tasking, Kassia tries to keep it simple in this life. Indeed, having dealt with life and death very pragmatically in her previous realm, these days she's a far more peace-loving soul who is never sure why she feels unfulfilled. The advice from the commentary box K: get outside, get your hands dirty and involve yourself in tasks that test you physically and mentally. You'll be bored everywhere else.
Kassie: Kassie thinks those girls who strut down the catwalk are piss-poor examples of womanhood. She can't stomach men who can't wield a hammer, only because she's pretty handy with one herself, and if ever she was to go out on a date with a fellow, she quite literally wouldn't know how to deal with a man who rushed around and opened her car door for her. However, when they meet her, everyone is surprised to discover how feminine and cute Kassie looks. But, yes, under that welcoming smile is the REAL DEAL. No question.
Kat: Yes, well, once upon a time we may have described Kat as the genial Lab Technician, and that may or may not have been correct. But here’s a weird thing, and I’ll let you in on a little secret…..girls whose names begin with the letter ‘K’ are on average, give or take, obviously, the most potent group of women in the Kingdom. I’d explain that story but it’d take too long, but Kat here is something of an Enigma in that she is calm, she is placid, and she literally (subconsciously) rebels against the cat-ness in her name. You don’t believe me? I don’t care. I’m telling you, Kat is nice, she is just a nice, good person and far nicer than any of us up here giving directions. Amen.
Katana:
Bogan parents means we just hope she gets the hell out. 

The End.
Kate: I’d check for rocks first, but Kate is the name of the breath you take before diving into a perfect blue sea. If it’s a good day you’ll see the rocks, no worries, and if it’s a really good day then she’ll take your breath away. No question.
Katea: Katea is highly principled and disciplined. That's not to say she doesn't possess an excellent sense of humour - she does - it's just that, like the Germans, for instance, something as banal as a fart joke isn't necessarily going to resonate with her. She's deeper than that, ladies and gentlemen.
Katelin: Nothing gentle or forgettable here, folks. For the most part I'd recommend checking out Caitlin, but there's an important difference: Caitlin's trains are two big old steam clunkers where as this Katelin's are two Japanese speed trains. If you're in the driver's seat when they meet they would find nothing, but what a way to go!
Katelyn:
Now here is a girl who doesn’t require too much external stimulation to get fired up about a project. She works diligently and with a goal in mind, but she’s not so blinkered that she flips out if an unexpected horse pokes its head in the bedroom window and takes a mouthful of precious notes while she’s writing up her Ph.D thesis. Rather than sending it off to the knackery and making a few bucks, she’d probably use the opportunity to have a go at learning to ride the creature, which is her approach to life as a whole.
Charlatans and liars are strictly a no-go area, however, even if they’re funny.
Katerina: Nervously, the young man telephones Katerina to ask her on a date. Quickly she says, "Great! Love to! How about I pick you up? 8 o'clock okay?" Relieved, he agrees. When the night arrives Katerina screeches to a halt out the front of his home at 7.59. He's ecstatic but he's sweating...
Kath: Kath is one of the most down-to-earth and knockabout women in the Kingdom but luck doesn’t always run with her. The hard ‘th’ at the end of her name might act as some kind of blockage or crossroad, it’s hard to say, but know this: she is a passionate and sensitive soul, reactive too, who only wants to see good deeds done.
Katharine: Katharine leans over anyone who writes her name, and so much so that she is developing a hunchback. So, Katharine, don't worry about how they spell it and stop being a pain about it. You're tougher than that so go on, get on with it!
Katherine: The name of a fine leather horse stirrup that is polished and taught, and ready for the day’s parade. (ie. Katherine is organised, she has a healthy ego, she has high standards and as for party drugs, forget it!)
Kathleen: I know, I know, her name sounds like the horrible screech produced when you drag your fingernails across a blackboard. Thankfully no one is that painful - well, except maybe a bloke called Rocko – and Kathleen has recovered to become a worthy country girl who pulls her weight and attempts to get the job done. Amen to that Kathleen.
Kathrina: Her daddy drives a big fat Range Rover - one of many owned by the family because they're good at getting around horse properties. Kathrina was brought up loving horses, naturally, and she's a determined girl, no question, accepting only certain types of behaviours. It helped her win an equestrian gold medal and if she plays her cards right she'll probably win another one at the next olympics, too.
Kathryn: Too organised to mismanage either the companies financial records or her families, Kathryn understands that someone needs to keep their feet on the ground otherwise the whole train will end up derailing. The last thing Kathryn needs is another mess to clean up. In fact, fuck it, Kathryn we up here in the box think you deserve a fun holiday. The Cayman Islands - do you want to go? We've got a spare ticket...
Kathy: You know how a Valium makes you relaxed and ambivalent about everything? (They’re excellent to take before a long bus trip). Anyway, the Kathy Pill works in exactly the opposite way.
Katina: The Sling Shot. Handle with care, or not. No matter. Katina is here to play RIGHT NOW. And she'll play in a supremely optimistic fashion whether you want to or not, god bless her.
Katja: The German DJ who breaks hearts by just being in the room. She exudes erotic greatness and she’s generous and funny, better than that her music could change the fucking world. Did I mention her deadly smile, and how much more do you want to know?…
Katrice: Well, if you're going to juggle chainsaws for a living, I'd like to see you do it and not frown!
Katriese: The beautiful archer who is impossible to distract as the pressure mounts. She expects a lot from her lovers and partners and she doesn't settle for dead-beats. Why would you?
Katrin: Relentless in her artistic pursuits, Katrin often doesn't care if she lives like a pauper, so long as she is being satisfied on a deeper, artistic or philosophical level. Usually it never comes to that, however. Katrin is quite direct in her dealings, whether she has a French ancestry or not, and she is considered a bitch by only those who are mentally frail, so let's ignore them. Katrin is passionate in love as she is in life and we're not sure if, over the entire course of human history, a girl called Katrin has ever arrived at the end of her life at a location which is closer than 500 km to the place of her birth. Yep, figuratively and literally, this girl was born to travel.
Katrine: Question: Is Katrine the worst reverse parallel parker on the planet?
Kattherrine: Some names catapult people into a line of society that deals with nice cars, a bit of bling, good schools for the kids and no mechanical knowledge whatsoever. If an asteroid strike was to decimate the electricity grid, for instance, Kattherrine wouldn't survive for long, but then again....maybe we underestimate her? Her name is like a convoluted maze lined with plush red velvet, so perhaps she'd find a way. Yes, she's sophisticated, but the craziness of the spelling of her name has also handed her a certain serenity which enables her to not give a flying fuck about things which are out of her control. Know what I mean?
Katy: Katy is less self-assured and she takes longer to make a decision than her sister, Katie, but there's no shame in that. Most people are. Katy is a little shy around strangers, she loves animals and she's something of a home-body.
Kay: A paper cut. Not life threatening. No hospital required. It stings in the shower but, luckily, it heals quickly. (i.e - Kay can handle herself and she hasn't time for airy-fairy bullshit.)
Kaya: Kaya is slightly off the ground like a hovercraft. Smooth in movement and sexy in flight, she pines for the day when she can relax in knowing what she wants in the world, and thereby afford herself the time and space to relax without some unnerving feeling that she's not doing enough with her life.
Kaye: The Nurse, be it metaphorically or otherwise.
Kaylee: Kaylee rarely does anything without thinking of others first. She might even be a modern day Dorothy.
Kayleen:
“Ya canna’ hand a man a granda’ spanna’....”
(ie: She’s a realist, she doesn’t talk shit and she gets on with things.)
Kayleigh: With a name like this you might imagine that Kayleigh lives for parties and drinking and cavorting. But alas, Kayleigh is a conscience student who is aiming high. Likewise, her moral standards are not set lowly and she tends to fill her life with interesting, educated and funny people who love her company as much as she loves theirs. Many people in the Kingdom would do well to observe how she goes about her life.
Kaylene: Kaylene is just as happy in the slaughterhouse of a Christmas morning mulitiple-family gathering as she is in the real thing with a giant knife in her hand and about to carve up a freshly killed beast. Kaylene will roll her sleeves up and get stuck in. Simple as that.
Kaz: What a bloody delight! Kaz is the perfect mix of Issy, Lorraine, Nat and Trish, and perhaps even a sprinkling of a tipsy Isabella who is wearing a red satin dress that stops just above the knees.
Kazza: One of the most well-rounded & loved humans in the Kingdom. She is also one of the boys.
Keeley: Dynamic, powerful and ready, Keeley ensures the pace of the race is never lost and that everybody else knows exactly where they’re going and what they’re supposed to be doing.
Keera: If confined to an office cubicle there is a fair chance Keera would be carted off to a mental asylum within a week. This girls needs the outdoors like she needs oxygen to breathe. Even then, it's the crowds that get to her. Sure, she can handle the odd music festival where crowds represent most of the fun, but even then she's looking forward to getting away from the hustle and bustle.
Keira: Yup, her dad was, and hopefully still is, a surfin' man. Perhaps her mum too. And all that chilled out salt-water vibe has carried right on down the line. As an adult Keira now runs an ashram in northern India. What a delicious swarmi she is!
Keisha: Like several others in the Kingdom, Keisha doesn’t have a nasty bone in her body – it’s a beautiful thing – and for a job, therefore, you’ll find her working either for a society that protects animals, or in a Cambodian orphanage.
Keitha: Keitha likes people and she therefore likes places where they gather. As you can imagine then, Keitha loves her job as The Party Planner!
Keiva: Natural and earthy, Keiva attracts friends like she attracts luck. If a piece of music could be ascribed to her, imagine, if you will, a nice piano lead-in which reminds you of the time you met up with that old flame you hadn’t seen for years, and who you’ll never stop loving.
Keli: Pretty girl, lots of friends and she's no fool, but does she see the project through to the end? Maybe she needs a bit of Bruce Lee tuition - the famous Kung Fu and martial artist who once said, when you're punching at something, don't aim for the surface of it, aim for one inch behind it. And once success becomes a habit for this girl, look out!!
Keller: Is she a dedicated genius or is she just drifting along?  She’s almost incredible but.....where is the unpredictable spark? We know it’s there, but we just want to see it!
Kelli: An attractive reporter from any one of the commercial television networks. She doesn’t quite understand our system of parliament, the legal world or the finer points of the financial markets but you’d never know it, and she dyes her hair strawberry blonde at least once every year.
Kellie: I know, you've got an E at the end but don't worry, you're just about identical to your soul sister above, Kelli. She just happened to appear on the team list before you. Management.
Kelly: Kelly is physically attractive, outgoing and funny, but she is the sort of girl who, six months after the event, insists that all of her friends come around to watch her 4 hour wedding video.
Kelsey: In the old pirate days, if ever a ship ran aground and needed mending on the outside of the hull as well as the inside, they'd seek Kelsey's assistance. Yes, they'd ensure there were no sharks around, but only she could stay relaxed enough to both hold her breath for a long time and operate with speed and diligence. She's quite a calm soul this one, and very determined once she's given a project she can sink her teeth into, so to speak. Boys love her.
Kelsie: Spicy and tasty, Kelsie is a type of sauce that performs somewhere between straight tomato sauce, HP, Worcestershire, Tobasco and Sweet Chilli. True, not many restaurants have ever heard of her, but she has a small if not very dedicated band of fans.
Kendall: Kendall parties hard and works harder, and she’s fantastic under pressure.
Kendell: Kendell, like her sister above, doesn't mince words, rarely wastes a minute and endeavours to fill her life with fun projects. Occasionally the moments overflow, but she deals with it.
Kendelle: Some people just attract controversy, don't they. Don't get us wrong, Kendelle is no hell-raiser, although this happens from time to time, but she enjoys being close to where it's happening. If she's feeling whimsical and on a walking tour of the rim of a volcano, part of her would be quite excited by the prospect of how she might die if the thing  were to erupt good and proper. (Note: don't offer her the keys late at some party or other because she might just take them, and she's rarely the designated driver.)
Kendra: The 'out-there' girl who loves nothing better than a good dare. If you take her to a football game, for example, unless you want to find yourself spending hours at a police station after the game awaiting to bail her out of lockup, the last thing I'd do, after a few beers, is jokingly suggest to her that one of you should strip off and run naked across the ground.
Kennedy: As Pippa's distant cousin, Kennedy is a professional bull rider. And the bigger the bull the better.
Kenzie:
Not a dainty type, Kenzie prefers it when she's out in the forest or the bush, camping.
Towing people who are bogged: she likes this.
Fending off crocodiles or bears: she loves that.
And she definitely hates being invited to weddings because it means she has to put on all that girly shit which she detests 93% of the time.
Keoni: Never plump, Keoni has a ton of energy. Up here in the commentary box we've come to realise that Keoni loves playing in the mud, because then she can dive in after the ball and crash into opponents without hurting herself but hurting them. As far as we can tell all she needs to become a champion is a little bit of direction. Where's the coach?
Keren: When confronted with the grind of daily life, Keren doesn't shirk her responsibilities. However, in her guts she believes that, as a gifted artist and entertainer, it's not really her job to deal with such things. Underlings exist to deal with this kind of shit, don't they? But, she's a lovely lady with a kind smile and an excellent social awareness.
Keri: Notions of honour, justice and integrity run deeply through this lass, and like a male Spiro she might look quite serious. There’s always a trade off somewhere with Keri however, you just need to find it. Maybe she’s an avid skydiver? Perhaps she’s famous at the local BDS&M club? Maybe she sculpts?
Keris: Smart girl with a very dry sense of humour. Mam', don't spell her name wrong else you'll go straight to the bottom of her list, but she wont obsess about it...usually. Not prone to standing around being idle, Keris is proactive and not easily dissuaded from her course of action if she believes in it. She doesn't understand slap-stick comedy at all and she's never overweight.
Kerri: Always chatty and full of opinions, most of which are sound, Kerri is a spritely lass who always means well. Indeed, she might be very similar to Kerrie!
Kerri-Anne: A Bronze Whaler shark about 8 feet long. She looks amazing and, boy, can she move? But, Jesus H Christ, if her blood is up and you’re in the water you need to have eyes in the back of your head…
Kerrie: A modern & empowered woman who, if feeling frisky on a train journey, might be so bold as to secretly slip her hand into the trousers of her betrothed in broad daylight and have a midday play. Life is for living and Kerrie does plenty of that. However, it's not to say her children (and family in general) give her the shits, she just enjoys it when they leave home so she can get back to being young at heart again.
Kerrin:
Life can be tough sometimes. Life can be difficult. Life can drag and drag like a tired old hound whose been attached to the same old chain for months.
OR
Life can be vivid, and startling, and silly, and frivolous, and saucy, and completely embarrassing. You don’t even have to wear clothes if you don’t want to.
Kerrin, we think it’s time for you to end the former chapter, relax about how the fools spell your name, and begin the latter.
As you know, we are all but players in the most ridiculous game of all.
Amen to that.
Kerry: Kerry is the sensation you feel in your nose, throat and chest when you begin to chew and swallow a mothball that you mistook for a large white mint.
Kerryl:
Kerryl is far too normal and too much of a realist to want to spend hours in front of the mirror attending her mascara.
"Get off the bloody couch and get out into the world!" is what she tells people who are needlessly complaining about their lives. Her children therefore have no choice other than to use their initiative, which is most of the battle. Nice work Kerryl.
KerryLynnette: Ever watch the TV show M*A*S*H? You have? Excellent! Well, Radar O’Reilly IS Kerry Lynnette. Fortunately, or otherwise, someone in the household has to deal with the little chores, has to inform people of their tasks, has to nag at others to clean shit up and organise themselves so the place runs smoothly. Yep, she’s over it and she probably needs a holiday, but some habits are hard to break. Suffice to say if she weren’t around the place would fall apart.
Kerryn: Kerryn is a great buddy to have at university. She never misses any of the lectures, which is fabulous for those that occasionally do, and she understands what is being said even when you attended, but lacked the mental capacity to phathom what the hell they were babbling on about. God bless you Kerryn!
Kersti-Li: So what if her parents fed her only meat and sweet biscuits. Better than nothing, right? Oh well, at least she's left home by now. These days Kersti-Li aspires to work at a chocolate factory. Apparently you're permitted to eat as much chocolate as you like. Most people get sick of it pretty quickly. Kersti-Li ain't 'most people', however.
Kerston: The no-nonsense negotiator. She reads people as quickly as she sees the solution to most problems and she rarely has time to deal with trivial issues. The Big Picture - this is what she's good at. In that regard she always looks a little serious, but not to those who know her well. Always well groomed and attractive, she's reasonably intolerant of fools and is a passionate lover, so long as her partner behaves.
Keryn: Never slack like some people, Keryn was born to complete the job. She’s one of the least ego-filled people we know and all we wish for is for her to receive many more surprise moments of oral pleasure than she currently enjoys, which is basically none.
Keshia: Rather undemanding, Keshia keeps to herself and shies away from attention. It's not that she falls apart if the spotlight is shined upon her, it's just that her ego isn't the driving force in her life. She's quite introspective in that way. She's not dull, trust me, but she'd make a wonderful scientist because she can dedicate herself to a line of study, mostly because she wants to see good things happen to the planet and to the creatures that inhabit it, be they human or otherwise.
Kettie:
“Well, thing is officer, I admit that yes, I did spend $50 in that store with a counterfeit note. It’s true, and for that I am guilty, but as for the huge counterfeit machine in that warehouse, I have no idea whose it is. Me and some friends stumbled upon it and thought, what the hell,” Kettie says, down at the station.
The detective looks at her, and Kettie's cheeky grin leaves him with nowhere to go. He drops his head. “.....Okay,” he says. “I believe you. You can go.”
Once she’s gone he tells a couple of cops to trail her, which they do. They follow her to the airport, they watch her buy $3 million in traveller’s cheques and they watch her get on a plane to India. Nice work Kettie.
Keturah:
Does 'Keturah' rhyme with 'Drama'?  Well, let me just have a look. Firstly, no way would Keturah stand for being the secret mistress. Not a chance. She's the main attraction in this show kids, so if the coveted man/lover in her life isn't prepared to join the show full-bottle then they will be shown the exit door, just over there at stage left. What else?...
An office job: not bloody likely. 
Children: Mmmm, perhaps, but later rather than sooner. (There's an ego here that needs to wash off a bit before we jump into being fully responsible, but maybe it's what she needs!) 
But, in summation, she's damn cute, everyone loves her and this, ladies and gentlemen, will take her a very long way.
Kezia: Another stressed copywriter blasts his way into his boss's office where he finds his boss with her feet on her desk, her long legs crossed. Before he speaks Kezia raises a hand to silence him. “Look, just fuckin' calm down and relax…..now, tell me slowly, what's the problem?"
Keziah:
Keziah is an inconvenience to people who don’t enjoy speaking the truth, only. You’d never see her employed at government house, for instance. She’d never get a job working for a used car dealership and can you imagine how long she’d last at a famed marketing agency?
On the other hand, she’d be a skilled oncologist (because if nothing else she likes to get to the root of the problem) and in a million years you’d never see her working in a jewellery shop. 
Keziah has a hippy name, sure, but there ain’t no $150 yoga outfits here folks. Keziah is real. 
(Note: Her parents aren’t rocket scientists however.)
Khadija: The fact that the oldest and wisest souls are usually the most playful should be a nice reminder for the rest of us. Complications exist only in the mind, not here in this moment. Such is Khadija, and such is life.
Khali: Mmm, she sounds sedate, doesn't she? Well, good luck with that idea. Khali is resolute in her attack on life inside her various pursuits and, well, it's not as though she's undisciplined, she just rips things to pieces, do you know what I mean? But she's fun at the same time. She must drive her parents batty.
Khoby: Khoby isn't a trail-blazer as such, but she trails about 15 metres behind them. This means that she enjoys the challenges of life, but doesn't often reap the rewards of having gone out on a limb, herself. Rarely glum.
Khody: Yeah, see Khoby, give or take, although this one isn't as sure of her decisions. And like her kindred sister, Khody doesn't spend days depressed in her room.
Khristie: See Kristy. I know Khristie, you hate that but look on the bright side - you're not a shy girl and you don't live in Iran, Pakistan or Afghanistan. Have you thought about what life is like for your sisters over there?
Khristina: No, she doesn't work 70 hours per week but so what? That's not her gig. BUT Khristina IS sensual and indispensable. She doesn't run the company, but she knows all the loop-holes and good drinking spots, she's a wonderful if not very subtle flirt and she seems to have more holidays than anyone else. How she does it is anyone's guess.
Khristy: Another potent horse wrangler, possibly literally but definitely metaphorically. Khristy is as sexy as she is full-on, and she is a prime example of how the idea of a simple, quite life for some people is but a distant pipe dream. If she is your partner, can we suggest you do her a favour by surprising her with a wee getaway holiday. She’ll thank you forever.
Kia: You know that feeling - you arrive at the supermarket after a nice day on the beach, surfing, sunbathing or whatever, and you're contemplating what you're going to have for dinner. You stand there in the fruit n' veg section before wandering around, aimlessly, waiting for inspiration to strike. As the minutes pass you realise that you're actually quite thirsty and it's at that moment you spy the grapes. And just look at them - they're green, they're fat, they're glistening with cold condensation fresh from the heavens and, by god, you've never seen anything more delicious and refreshing in your life. Kia.
Kiaan: A Textbook Hipster Girl. Cute, funny, educated and with little or no clue as to how to deal with catastrophe, so long as the planet doesn't slip into another great depression Kiaan will do just fine. Lithe and lean from all that yoga.
Kiah: In the trenches in world war one, commanders at the front line would give their messages to Kiah. She was always their best bet in terms of getting it back to HQ in one piece. Why? Because she moves very quickly and very stealthily under the radar. She knows all the secret passageways, she knows when to keep her head low and she knows when she has to throw caution away and run like the wind. She's make a great tactician on a racing yacht.
Kiana: Rarely will you see Kiana livid at someone. As Bruce Lee once said, "Be like water". Adapt, bend, mould to your surroundings, absorb the shock, walk around the pain, slide on through the good bits and enjoy them when you can. Kiana does all this. Horses love her because she's centred.
Kiara: Intense but nice; serious but not; intelligence not genius; travelled but homely; arty but sort of naive.
Kiarna: Far happier outdoors than in. Cities are okay for Kiarna but they probably need to be near the coast where she can get seawater on her skin at least occasionally. Work-wise it's anyone's guess, but her boyfriends, lovers and partners will need to let her go and do her thing from time to time. It's probably wise advise for all of us, actually.
Kiera: See Kirra, almost, except Kiera is just that little bit more sensitive, and she shaves her legs more (but never so much as someone like, Coco, for example).
Kiera-Louise: KL drips with diamonds and pearls in the same way that she drips with affection and laughter, and so it makes sense that she provides the most exquisite and beautiful food of any non-practicing chef on the planet.
Kiki: Yeah yeah, she’s beautiful like a Swedish Dolphin, but forget all that. Because, these days, after having not seen her for a week, Kiki walks up to you with a big cheeky smile, and asks you if you’ve been kissing anyone this week, all the while jabbing you in the ribs with hard, ticklish forefingers that are coming too fast and too hard to defend.
Killiana:
Well, we can't say she condones strong-arm tactics but then again, we haven't seen her in a life-and-death situation recently. What Killiana doesn't do, however, is sit around whining and complaining about what did or didn't happen. Sure, life is complex sometimes, and occasionally you don't get what you think you deserve, even though in the end, it turns out you did: Killiana is pretty adept at reminding others of this simple but rather confronting fact. It helps that she's got a great smile, but so what. The other thing she'll tell you is to use what you've got. 
Thanks K.
Kim:
Kim actually holds a record in the Kingdom for possessing the greatest ratio of:                
Complexity of nature/Name length.
Indeed, Kim is sensual, she is worldly, she is determined and, yes, she is complex.
Kimber: A sexual being, which is a good thing. She's up there with Fergus, Laurina, etc etc.
Kimberley: Kimberley has the I.Q of unknown proportions but that doesn’t matter. In a world where looks count, she does alright. She’s a lingerie model, and she’s organised.
Kimmy: Flighty and superficial one day, hilarious and dangerous the next. Like a man called Muchy, she can’t sit in the one spot for more than about 10 minutes.
Kinga: Kinga never goes to bed without handcuffs, an array of oils and some pretty funky music.
Kinsey: Super smart, very cute and with a mind that rarely switches off, Kinsey takes ages to get to sleep every night. She basically runs work without being the boss, which she's over, to be honest, and she detests wearing high heels.  Kinsey's defining characteristic however is that she's brilliant at getting to the root cause of things. She's make an excellent psychiatrist, investigative journalist, scientist or activist.
Kinza: All the boys want to turn her into a lollypop so they can stuff her in their mouth. Some girls have that effect on men. As it is, Kinza snuggles into her particular maze of work and living and play so well that she barely seems to have a problem. She’s not needlessly rude to anyone.
Kio: Is she Inuit, Russian, Greek or English? No one is certain but none of that is really relevant. Kio dives into situations and this is her special skill. That’s not to say she carries no fear but she needs to test herself from time to time, which is why her hobbies/men/romantic intersts/friends seem out of the ordinary. Life is an interesting game for Kio, and we will do well to see what she says about it.
Kipa: By pure accident, usually, Kipa is gifted slapstick comedienne.
Kira: Yep, Kira was conceived in the ocean and she's a little more timid than her cousin (Kirra), which is a good thing!
Kiraley: Her boyfriend/partner needs either a good sense of humour or plenty of that thing that we call PATIENCE. It's all about melodrama, you understand. Kiraley lives for it. If no one is producing then she'll take it upon herself to produce a melodramatic moment, personally. You should see her in action when she's tipsy and footloose.
Kiran: Man, look out! If she ever performed as the official starter for the 100m sprint at the Olympic Games, she wouldn't fire the gun into the air, no sir! At the sound of the pistol the runner in the field whom she most detested will be shot in the leg. (Proof that she treats the whole thing as a game.)
Kirby: Chews chewy at the back of the class.
Kiri: Kiri allows herself only so much down-time before she stands up, dusts herself off and heads stridently back out into the field with her guide book, her sample vials and her trusty sextant.
Kirily: Kirily, you've got all the crew up here in the commentary box in a bit of a tizz. We didn't think another Kirrily-type existed. They do. You do. Here you are. Can you please go and check out Kirrily. Love your work. (Management.)
Kirra: The cute and compassionate tomboy who lives near the coast and is perpetually sun-kissed. And no, she probably not the most fiscally responsible person you have ever met
Kirralea: The more dashing cousin of Jeanette, Kirralea is the bushfire that no one can seem to put out. And why would you want to?
Kirralee: Each of us has a skill. It's just how it is. Sometimes it takes a while to figure out what that is, and sometimes it takes others to remind us what we are particularly gifted at. This is the situation which applies to Kirralee. Yes, she's a smart, canny lass who doesn't spend too much time sitting around moping, but what she's great at is needlessly slamming car doors. She doesn't even have to be in a hurry. She might even be early to some funtion or other that she's not even that keen on attending, but there you go - out she gets - and BANG! She scares the shit out of valets and used car salesmen, and rightly so. Interestingly, she exits relationships in a similar fashion.
Kirrilea: Kirrilea is the name given to a rock-slide or avalanche. Yep, it's true, sometimes she kills people but if they're on the mountain after the warnings go up, what do you expect? Kirrilea is a natural function of life, as we all are. So, now, if you're about to head on out to the mountain for a trek/heli-ski you need to ensure you're prepared. Have you told people where you are going? Do you have provisions if you get lost or buried, and have you got an EPIRB? In a nutshell, sort your shit out and you'll be okay. Kirrilea.
Kirrily:
The morning after a big night, and you wake on the couch. The house is peaceful and quiet and that's a good thing. You have a mouthful of water from the full glass which miraculously appeared on the floor next to where you're sleeping - you're pretty sure you never put it there - and just when you feel like it's okay to fall back to sleep, a car pulls up loudly out the front, music blaring until the ignition is turned off.
Kirrily blasts through the door, sunglasses on and carrying lots of plastic bags that seem to be full. "Come on you - up! I've got some panadol, I've got a roast chicken and all the salad stuff. We're off to the beach! Come on! Up!!!!"

So much for the quiet, chilled-out recovery - and she was partying harder than anyone. Kirrily.
Kirsha: No woman is an island but Kirsha does alright. She studied art design at university although no one knows if she scored a job in that field or not. She’s quite an intense lady…intense but nice.
Kirstan: Don't be late if she's invited you around for dinner. As in, don't be 30 seconds late. If you're on time, then no worries. You won't find a more loving and hospitable host, and she's a wonderful flirt. But if you're late then the whole plan for the evening is likely to be thrown out the window and the last thing we need is Kirstan stressed in a place where she can get her hands on a variety of big, sharp knives. Great smile though.
Kirsteen: Wow, she'd be wild to live with, huh? One minute she'd be in the garden, using brute force to position railway sleepers for her new vegie patch, the next minute she's out the door, dolled up to the nines and dripping with jewellery and perfume that the neighbours can smell from over the road. They probably heard her getting ready too - screaming out if anyone has seen her fucking car keys. So, no, Kirsteen is anything but forgettable.
Kirsten: As one of life’s great reality checks, Kirsten is the name of that irritating pebble in your shoe that is hard to find, even after you take your shoe off. Don’t let her operate any kind of machinery, whatsoever, although she is great with animals. And she never gives up easily.
Kirsti: Like all girls with this kind of name, Kirsti doesn't die wondering. Her smile is large, as may be her hips and the sound of her laughter. She forgives after a loud fight and most of her friends will attest to her fiery will. Never as reliable as a man called Geoff, for instance, but Kirsti brings verve and life and sexy banter. Thanks Kirst'.
Kirstie: Kirstie may be small but she's not small in spirit. For instance, she'd make a great jockey. And she persists more than nearly anyone. She loves the outdoors and if she did become a jockey, the horses would really dig her energy.
Kirstine: Kirstine is the name given to the phenomenon of waking up early, and on the way to the kitchen where you plan to make a quiet coffee on your own, you pause at the stereo to turn on some mellow tunes. In your memory the volume was low from the night before and the music quite chilled - perfect, you think - but no. The volume was turned up flat-stick and it's fuckin' Kanye West screaming at you. By the time it comes on, nearly blasting the windows from their frames, you are already at the kitchen sink and faced with a desperate eight metre return dash across slippery tiles in order to kill the stereo before the entire house is awoken. Kirstine.
Kirsty:
Faulty and defective? I doubt it. But no one is perfect, and the only hiccups arise for her when she acts without thinking, which usually only stems from moments of unbridled gusto and enthusiasm that are too powerful to repress.
True, we once described Kirsty as Samantha, from 'Sex in the City’, but that’s doing her a disservice, for there’s way more to this girl than just being forthright in the bedroom. 
Kirsty has a vision and she aspires to fulfil it, regardless whether that vision exists in three weeks time or not. When confronted with such passion, her friends go out of their way to help her too, such are her powers of persuasion. But we say again, Kirst’, if you can, just remember that this moment won’t last forever, and sometimes it’s okay to relax for a little while and just see how things play out. Big Love, Management. x
Kisha: Kisha can get herself into a fizz very quickly and in dealings with the public she is therefore funny to watch. She speaks the truth of the matter and more than once has she chided a boyfriend in a very public display of anger. A nightmare relationship with most electronic devices means she needs a new phone every other week, although we have no idea how she pays for them.
Kissaine: Rarely tacky or cheap, Kissaine has an eye for composition, be it interior design or her own artwork. She can be a tad lazy, however. Several times last season we in the commentary box suspected she hit the ball out of play deliberately just so she could have a drink and wee sit down.
Kit: Like a soft leather holster for an expensive handgun, Kit has time, she's smooth and she smells incredible.
Kitty: Kitty runs a business that sells sexual dress-up clothes for adults.
Klara: Gorgeous or otherwise, Klara is a decent person with a good heart who follows the trends.
Klaudia: Klaudia is one funny chick and a firecracker of a personality. For instance, if you are living with her in a romantic situation, or even if you've just stepped out of the shower and can't be bothered wrapping a towel around yourself en route to your bedroom, if you pass Klaudia and she happens to be holding a plastic ruler - perhaps she is measuring the exact height of a small brass sculpture, having gotten into a drunk argument with some engineer wanker, who happened to be visiting the night before, that there's NO WAY it was taller than 25cm (Klaudia hates being wrong almost as much as she hates authority) - she will undoubtedly lash-out and slap you on your bare ass, leaving a big, red welt that will match the size of her grin. Klaudia.
Klytie: Like her name suggests, Klytie is ever so flighty. And she's over-reactive too, although she's quick to apologise when she's been a bit over the top or out of line.
Kobi: Jesus Kobi, what's the rush? Seriously, why are you running? There are things called subtlety, patience and timing. Yes, you can run into everything as fast as you can but let us tell you, sometimes a slow, dignified and knowing build-up is more erotic and mysterious than any hash job. Are you with me? So, take a breath, no one is dying here, and use a few seconds to imagine what it might be like to build a scenario over time. Go on...
Kobie:
“Mmm, well Miss Kobie, we hope you don't take after your twin sister above (Kobi). Ah, you say you don't? Excellent. Well then you might be able to help me with something. You see, I’ve heard a report that a girl looking very much like you was seen at the wheel of Miss Roderick’s Fiat, which she reported stolen at morning recess…..It wasn't you?…. Well, that's just splendid. But tell me, why is the bottom of your skirt torn? I only ask because the same person who witnessed the car leaving the road and drive through a hedge, said the driver was wearing a school skirt because it was hanging out the bottom of the driver's side door. 
…..I see, so you're saying it wasn't you, then?…..Well, it's a good thing your grades are so high Ms Kobie. Now please go back to class, and for god's sake get your mother to mend that skirt."
The End.
Kodi: A sneaky little trickster. Luck is her constant ally, as are her rather large group of friends. All the boys stand a little bit taller in her presence because deep down they know Kodi cannot stomach men who stand with their shoulders slumped.
Kodie: Small, smart and tenacious, Kodie is super-strong for her size. She has never heard of a thing called peer group pressure and she'd be very confused at what it even means.
Korina: Girls whose name begins with the letter K are never lacking ambition or potential and so here it is again. Korina never remains in a rut for long, because she will immediately scratch and fight and punch her way out of it. Usually it’s a battle with herself and as you can imagine, therefore, she finds pregnancy something of a chore because by necessity she has to sit around for long periods either feeling dodgy or just eating, and she enjoys having things to do amid an active life. She’s a wonderful ally and a passionate lover, and when she’s not pregnant she’s bloody difficult to pin down, which is just the way she likes it. Oh yeah, and she understands men very well. Got all that?
Kris: Kris will tell you that in order to take yourself back to your past lives, you have to stick your finger in your belly button, repeat your name over and over and over and walk backwards and forwards as you do it.
Krissi:
Late for kick-off again, is she? Bloody hell....oh hang on....here she comes. The umpire checks his watch. Krissi jogs out into the middle, takes her place in the lineup while 40,000 exasperated fans settle down in their seats.

Krissi looks at the umpire, gives him a silly kind of smile as if to say, "You wouldn't believe me if I told you."

He'd ask her, but he knows the story would take ages and while being generally hilarious and ridiculous, probably, now isn't the time for it.

All he says is, "Well, can we start now Krissi?"

She just nods.

And away we go again...
Krissie: You can imagine Krissie at two in the morning sitting around with her staff, a drink in hand, her feet up on the seat in front of her, a smoking cigarette held aloft, relaxing and laughing about another crazy night in this crazy city that went off without a hitch. Finally, we get to see the beautiful and full expanse of that smile of hers.
Krista: Like a lone Jelly Fish pulsating its way through a clean ocean, Krista often produces a wonderfully unusual spectacle, not to mention a different perspective on life, but it takes her ages to get anything done and if she’s in a bad mood when you touch her you’ll wear the scars.
Kristelle: Kristelle often finds herself in rather embarrassing public situations when, theoretically, she's being sexy and quite chic. For instance, she tried that seduction method of taking her knickers off while in a restaurant, once, in order to drive the man wild with lust who was sitting opposite her. It was going great until the final move when she bent down to secretively retrieve them off the last high heel. Unfortunately, because she'd drunk a few wines, she overbalanced and fell sideways, knocking the table into the air as she hit the ground. Food and wine went assunder, Kristelle hit the deck and bared her uncovered nether regions to the maitre d' while her knickers ended up in a sticky date pudding three tables away. Thank God she has a sense of humour, eh?
Kristen: World Peace isn’t really any of Kristen’s business and she accepts that she can’t make everyone happy. But, she is an extremely sensual woman, once she’s awake, and she sleeps most of the time because she seeks a stable state. Does that mean she’s lazy?.....yep, but who cares? You can’t get by at being lazy if you’re stupid and that she is not.
Kristi: Kristi is very pointy at both ends, which means that getting in past the entrance to her home/burrow/eagle's nest is only the beginning. If she she suddenly insists you go with her to go and 'pick something up', however, make sure you're armed. Good luck!
Kristian: Kristian is well-travelled and educated, not to mention rather refined. She only harps on about it when she’s drunk and she wouldn’t be seen dead kissing passionately in public, which is a shame.
Kristie: An orthodox hot water bottle that is made out of blue rubber. She bubbles and squeaks if you touch her on the belly.
Kristin: The Artful Dodger. (i.e: very smart, great escape artist, excellent memory, distracting smile.)
Kristina: The manager of Chicago's most popular wine bar, and she is good. No matter how busy, how chaotic or how loud it gets, Kristina is on the case. She makes decisions very quickly and very well, and no matter what the repercussions she retains her cool. The upshot of all this is that no matter what happens, Kristina gives the impression that she knew it was going to happen, and that it was all part of the grand plan.
Kristine: Kristine is a girl on a mission. Yes, she gets frustrated with little errors caused either by her or others which impede her progress, but she persists. Does she overdo it? Well, she certainly doesn't relax like she ought to, but then again, maybe that's her lot? The team in the commmentary box certainly love her never-say-die attitude.
Kristy: If she isn’t slightly dull then she is likely to be extremely energetic, in which case she is a possible lawyer, pole dancer or professional kick-boxer.
Kristyn: Why is it girls whose names start with K can bust down doors more easily than almost anyone? This one is no different. And she’ll take a fall, lose some skin and get right up again. Is the job finished? No? Well then don’t expect Kristyn to stop or sit down. Even watching her is making us tired…
Krystal: If the sun is out and she is in the mood, Krystal has the bad habit of racking up a huge and almost un-payable credit card debt.
Krystina: Krystina is the only person we are aware of who volunteered to work in the prison, on the condition that she was the one who got to flick the switch on Death-by-Electrocution day.
Krystle: You know of those horror stories about violent husbands? (They're not to be tolerated under any circumstance, not ever.) Anyway, if Krystle ever found herself in that predicament, well, I tell ya, the husband wouldn't be very violent for long. He'd very quickly find himself either six feet under, or starin' down the barrel of a gun and being confronted with the news that if he doesn't shape up and get loving, quick, then he soon will be. A- fuckin’-men.
Kumi: Kumi is a cross between Gwen Stefani and the Dalai Lama. The End.
Kwan:
If we put all the worlds troubles and all the world's angry, deluded fools into a single large bowl and give this bowl to Kwan, she will make everything better. How will she do it, you ask?…
Easy. She'll gently knead and fold the mixture over itself, bathing it in happy thoughts and a loving temperament, squeezing out all the dramas and all the hate, re-folding it again and again, until the process embalms the chaotic, angry mess with a strange kind of loving peace.
Kwan.
Kyhanna: Strong-arm tactics: forget it. Kyhanna's spirit wants to run free across the savannah, without the hang-ups, the obligations and the petty material concerns of the modern world. In a past life Kyhanna was an islander in the south pacific wearing a straw skirt, her hips and her delicious smile swaying in time to jungle drums, and where she hypnotised many-a-suitor. In that regard, at least, not much has changed. How she manages to get by in the Western world is beyond us, but get by she does.
Kyiah: We've been discussing Kyiah up here in the commentary box this week and we think she's a good player and that she has the capacity to be champion. But what we want to see is a bit more grunt!
